assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: text_decoder_of_multimodal: the graph prices the text decoder of a multimodal model: its vision or audio tower, and the encoder work a multimodal request adds, are not priced

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: max_cudagraph_capture_size
assumptions.Scope: 16: vLLM v0.31.0's default, min(max_num_seqs x decode_query_len x 2, 1024) (VllmConfig._set_cudagraph_sizes, vllm/config/vllm.py:2442-2460), as the deployment states neither max_cudagraph_capture_size nor cudagraph_capture_sizes; a step above it runs with no graph

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: max_cudagraph_capture_size
assumptions.Scope: 128: vLLM v0.31.0's default, min(max_num_seqs x decode_query_len x 2, 1024) (VllmConfig._set_cudagraph_sizes, vllm/config/vllm.py:2442-2460), as the deployment states neither max_cudagraph_capture_size nor cudagraph_capture_sizes; a step above it runs with no graph

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: text_decoder_of_multimodal: the graph prices the text decoder of a multimodal model: its vision or audio tower, and the encoder work a multimodal request adds, are not priced

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: max_cudagraph_capture_size
assumptions.Scope: 8: vLLM v0.31.0's default, min(max_num_seqs x decode_query_len x 2, 1024) (VllmConfig._set_cudagraph_sizes, vllm/config/vllm.py:2442-2460), as the deployment states neither max_cudagraph_capture_size nor cudagraph_capture_sizes; a step above it runs with no graph

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: max_cudagraph_capture_size
assumptions.Scope: 16: vLLM v0.31.0's default, min(max_num_seqs x decode_query_len x 2, 1024) (VllmConfig._set_cudagraph_sizes, vllm/config/vllm.py:2442-2460), as the deployment states neither max_cudagraph_capture_size nor cudagraph_capture_sizes; a step above it runs with no graph

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: text_decoder_of_multimodal: the graph prices the text decoder of a multimodal model: its vision or audio tower, and the encoder work a multimodal request adds, are not priced

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: max_cudagraph_capture_size
assumptions.Scope: 64: vLLM v0.31.0's default, min(max_num_seqs x decode_query_len x 2, 1024) (VllmConfig._set_cudagraph_sizes, vllm/config/vllm.py:2442-2460), as the deployment states neither max_cudagraph_capture_size nor cudagraph_capture_sizes; a step above it runs with no graph

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: text_decoder_of_multimodal: the graph prices the text decoder of a multimodal model: its vision or audio tower, and the encoder work a multimodal request adds, are not priced

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: max_cudagraph_capture_size
assumptions.Scope: 16: vLLM v0.31.0's default, min(max_num_seqs x decode_query_len x 2, 1024) (VllmConfig._set_cudagraph_sizes, vllm/config/vllm.py:2442-2460), as the deployment states neither max_cudagraph_capture_size nor cudagraph_capture_sizes; a step above it runs with no graph

assumptions.Name: engine_version

assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: text_decoder_of_multimodal: the graph prices the text decoder of a multimodal model: its vision or audio tower, and the encoder work a multimodal request adds, are not priced

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: max_cudagraph_capture_size
assumptions.Scope: 4: vLLM v0.31.0's default, min(max_num_seqs x decode_query_len x 2, 1024) (VllmConfig._set_cudagraph_sizes, vllm/config/vllm.py:2442-2460), as the deployment states neither max_cudagraph_capture_size nor cudagraph_capture_sizes; a step above it runs with no graph

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)
